verdict.rationale: WezTerm's own `wezterm cli` subcommand gives programmatic control of a running GUI or mux instance: it can spawn programs, manipulate tabs and panes, send text, read pane content and list windows/tabs/panes. A runtime probe confirmed this headless loop works without a GUI session. Nothing documents that this surface matches the full UI, and UI features like searchable scrollback and Quick Select are only described as keyboard or mouse interactions. Missing for 10: any documented claim or evidence of UI/API parity; programmatic coverage of UI features such as search, quick select, copy mode and font/color changes; a structured API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The _cli_ subcommand interacts with a running wezterm GUI or multiplexer instance, and can be used to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes.
